name: com.likeminds.feed.android.core.topicselection.view.LMFeedTopicSelectionActivity
description: LikeMinds Master Feed SDK (LikeMinds) opens this Activity when the user chooses community topics. It displays the topic-selection screen used to update the feed's topic choices.
disableEffect: Users cannot open the LikeMinds topic-selection screen to change their feed topics.
